title: Solar Bento — Pastel Product Feature Showcase
description: A sun-warmed bento board that anchors your product hero in a commanding 50% tile, then fans three or four pastel-tinted satellite tiles around it — each pairing a crisp line icon with a punchy benefit headline. Feels like an Apple product page compressed into a single, irresistible frame.

typography.heading: geometric humanist sans-serif, semibold weight, tight letter-spacing suited to punchy 4-7 word labels
typography.body: clean geometric sans-serif, regular weight, optimized for ultra-short benefit lines and icon captions

layoutNotes: Canvas sits on a warm cloud-white base (#faf9f7) governed by a 12-column grid with 5% horizontal margins and 40px fixed gutters between every tile. The hero product tile spans 6-7 columns at full canvas height, occupying roughly 50% of total area and anchored left or center; three to four satellite feature tiles fill the remaining space in a 2×2 or L-shaped wrap. All tiles use 24px border radii, with surfaces alternating a soft mint tint and a peach tint over off-white, never stacking two identical tints adjacent. Inside each satellite tile the line icon is pinned top-left at 32px, followed immediately by the benefit headline in large semibold type — no body copy block is permitted.
promptCore: Design a slide with the warm confidence of an Apple product page compressed into a single bento frame — one commanding hero tile anchors the product at visual center while pastel-tinted satellite tiles fan outward in a modular wrap, each pairing a crisp line icon with a punchy benefit headline. Composition feels effortless and sun-warmed, with soft alternating tile tints building rhythm without visual noise. No body copy blocks, no decorative borders — just icon-plus-headline economy, generous tile breathing room, and surfaces that let the product do the talking.
goodFor: SaaS or consumer-app feature announcements in a pitch deck
Single-slide 'why choose us' product marketing overviews
App onboarding decks showcasing 3-4 core capabilities
Feature callouts where each benefit needs equal visual weight
avoidFor: Multi-paragraph feature descriptions requiring body copy
Data-heavy slides with embedded charts or comparison tables
Sequential step-by-step process or timeline flows
Slides with more than four distinct feature callouts
